analysis.title: GS Futures Global Equity CTA - Market Update - November 09, 2026
key_insights: The desk's baseline flow forecast for 11/9 is similar to last Friday's, in mildly larger size: about $23bn of net global equity selling.
In North America the desk estimates nearly $36bn of selling, nearly all of it in SPX.

The medium-term SPX trend signal is about 2.3% away from the threshold at which it would flip positive again. That is well above a 2sd weekly return for the SPX, so the desk says a trend reversal is unlikely even if the SPX trades up this week.
With positioning estimated a little shy of $20bn and a flow forecast around $31bn, the desk expects systematic trend followers to be short SPX by the end of the week.
risk_factors: The trend signal is unlikely to reverse this week even if the SPX rallies, so the selling pressure from trend followers persists unless the SPX rises well beyond a 2sd weekly move.
